text: Miri said, “I want to show Dot a small shadow.” Kit told Miri, “I would like a dragon.” Miri borrowed the torch. Miri moved the torch. The shadow grew. Kit read the instruction label. Miri said, “I need to steady the torch.” Miri steadied the torch with the clay wedge. Miri moved the paper moth toward the screen. The shadow shrank. Dot said, “I can try.” Dot held the paper moth beside the screen. The shadow was small.
